record.dic_text:
03902 Lachmiy {lakh-mee'}

源自 03899; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Lahmi 1; 1

拉哈米 = "我的麵包"
1) 迦特人歌利亞的兄弟, 被睚珥的兒子伊勒哈難所擊殺 (#代上20:5|)
record.edic_text:
03902 Lachmiy {lakh-mee'}

from 03899;; n pr m

AV - Lahmi 1; 1

Lahmi = "my bread"
1) brother of Goliath the Gittite and slain by Elhanan the son of Zair
